activities.title: Children’s birthday parties
activities.description: Is it your birthday? Put on your apron and come prepare a healthy and tasty snack with your friends in a kitchen specially designed for children! You’ll leave with a small gift, some recipes, and lots of happy memories!

activities.title: Cooking workshops for school groups
activities.description: The whole class gets cooking to prepare a complete menu in our kitchen specially designed for children.

activities.title: Cooking together
activities.description: Take every opportunity to create seasonal specialties in full collaboration with your loved ones!

section.title: What's on?
section.infoText: Sharing knowledge and skills is what we do. With passion. That’s why the Alimentarium organises daily culinary workshops and classes led by qualified chefs.
